name: Honda Shadow 750
engine: 745 cc liquid-cooled V-twin, carbs to 2009, fuel injected from 2010
intro: Honda's middleweight cruiser. Carbs on early bikes, fuel injection later, and a bank angle sensor recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2010-2016 VT750s are in recall 15V874 for the bank angle sensor wire.
A-002.reason: If the sensor signal drops, the engine can stall while riding. The repair is free.

G-001.title: Find out which fuel system it has
G-001.instructions: 2004-2009 Shadow 750s use a carburetor. 2010 and later are fuel injected. Do the carb steps or the fuel injection check to match.
G-001.reason: The fuel steps are different for each.

recalls.what: Bank angle sensor wire can rub through and stall the engine.
recalls.fix: Dealer relocates the connector and replaces the sensor free.
